test_snapshot_download: test the snapshot_download function to download a repository to a cache directory with a specific revision
test_snapshot_download_private: test the snapshot_download function to download a private repository with an explicit token
test_snapshot_download_local_only: test the snapshot_download function to load a cached repository without network access
test_snapshot_download_offline: test the snapshot_download function to handle offline mode with cached or missing local data
test_snapshot_download_patterns: test the snapshot_download function to filter downloaded files using allow_patterns and ignore_patterns
